note: SPAX11 caused by TUBA4A variants causes progressive spastic ataxia with variable age of onset and reported adult-onset peripheral neuropathy, making the hypothesis biologically and clinically plausible.

evidence.text: Torella et al. identified a novel likely pathogenic TUBA4A variant (p.Glu415Lys) causing spastic ataxia in two families comprising 12 affected individuals, establishing TUBA4A as a cause of spastic ataxia (SPAX11).

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A
source.quote: In the present study, we report two families, one with 11 affected individuals and the other with a single patient, carrying a novel, likely pathogenic, variant (p. Glu415Lys) in the TUBA4A gene (NM_006000). The phenotype, not previously described, is that of spastic ataxia.

evidence.text: Benkirane et al. describe 12 patients from 11 unrelated families with TUBA4A variants presenting with spasticity and/or cerebellar ataxia with variable age of onset, expanding the clinical spectrum of hereditary spastic ataxia.

source.title: De novo and inherited monoallelic variants in TUBA4A cause ataxia and spasticity
source.quote: Herein, we describe 12 patients from 11 unrelated families harbouring ultra-rare missense... Our data confirm the identification of a hereditary spastic ataxia disease gene with variable age of onset, expanding the clinical spectrum of TUBA4A associated phenotypes.
